invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破73200（基于日线支撑和ATR），或融资费率Z-score回落至0%以下（风险缓解但需监控）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 73200 (based on daily support and ATR), or funding Z-score falls below 0% (risk eases but monitor).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.0995（基于ATR 0.0011和近期低点），或融资费率Z-score升至-100%以上（风险缓解但需监控）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.0995 (based on ATR 0.0011 and recent low), or funding Z-score rises above -100% (risk eases but monitor).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2280（基于ATR 19.96和支撑），或RSI回落至70以下且动量转负。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2280 (based on ATR 19.96 and support), or RSI falls below 70 and momentum turns negative.
